items.title: Code duplication pehchanna aur main function (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of code duplication and the main function (PDF 54-55).

blocks.text: Code duplication (code ka dohraya jana) tab hota hai jab ek hi code kai jagah baar baar likha ho. Yeh redundancy (faltu dohraav) code ki maintenance (sambhal) mushkil karti hai aur ghaltiyan (bugs) laati hai, kyunke ek change har jagah karna parta hai. Dohraya hua code pehchan kar usay ek function ya module mein rakhna efficient (achhi) modular programming ke liye zaroori hai.

Python mein main function batata hai ke program kahan se shuru ho. Isay aam taur par aise block mein bulaya jata hai jo check karta hai ke file seedhi chalayi gayi hai ya kisi aur file mein module ki tarah import hui hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"# main.py": comment: file ka naam.
"def main ( ) :": main naam ka function; is ke andar program ka asal kaam rakha jata hai.
"print("This is the main function.")": main ki body.
"if __name__ == "__main__" :": file seedhi chalayi jaye to Python __name__ ki value "__main__" rakhti hai, aur shart True hoti hai. Agar yeh file kisi aur file mein import ho to __name__ file ka naam hota hai aur shart False.
"main()": shart True ho to main function call hota hai.
Output: This is the main function. (Yahi file import ki jaye to kuch print nahi hota.)

blocks.prompt: File seedhi chalane par __name__ ki value kya hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: "__main__"; file import hone par __name__ module ka apna naam hota hai.

items: Code duplication se bachein; dohraya code function/module mein rakhein.
if __name__ == "__main__": main() sirf seedha chalane par chalta hai.
